rationale: The change revises the object-category scheme and explicitly affects FR-7.2.2, which is the source and revalidation basis for H1-CRD2 and H1-ORR2. The Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest are stated to remain unchanged, so the existing derivational basis remains applicable, but the satisfaction of H1-ORR2 must be reassessed because H1-A2/H1-RC2 require revalidation when FR-7.2.2, the object-category scheme, or the information used to represent object category changes.
